players.product: high-speed low-loss copper-clad laminates and prepregs (full series of dielectric-loss grades) for AI server and high-computing PCBs

quarterly_data.quarter: Shengyi Technology results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (08-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Chen Renxi (H1 2026 results briefing): the Thailand CCL project is expected to start production in September 2026 with capacity of about 40 ten-thousand sheets a month; the Dongguan Songshan Lake project (its 'Songshan Lake second plant', proceeding to plan) is expected to come into production in stages from H2 2027; Jiangxi Shengyi had H1 2026 revenue of about RMB 19 hundred million and net profit of about RMB 1.85 hundred million. Wholly owned Suzhou Shengyi signed a letter of intent with the Suzhou Industrial Park administrative committee for a new expansion project with intended investment of about RMB 50 hundred million; the plan is being drafted and will be announced after approvals. Some raw-material prices are at historical highs; current inventory is reasonable stock to secure order delivery.
quarterly_data.figure: Thailand CCL about 40 ten-thousand sheets a month from September 2026; Suzhou project about RMB 50 hundred million (intent)

quarterly_data.quarter: Shengyi Technology results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (08-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: General manager Zeng Honghui (H1 2026 results briefing): the company develops AI projects with major domestic and overseas end customers; its extremely-low-loss products have passed material certification at several domestic and overseas end customers and some are in volume supply. Board secretary Tang Fuyun said its full series of high-speed CCL grades serves servers, data centers, switches and optical modules.

players.product: IC-package copper-clad laminates (in volume for card, LED and memory-chip packages; in development for FC-CSP / FC-BGA AP, CPU, GPU and AI chips)

quarterly_data.quarter: Shengyi Technology results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (08-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: General manager Zeng Honghui (H1 2026 results briefing): the company's package-substrate materials are in large-volume use in wire-bond package substrates (sensors, cards, RF, cameras, fingerprint recognition, memory), are already in volume use in advanced packaging, and are being developed and applied in higher-end FC-CSP and FC-BGA packages for AP, CPU, GPU and AI products.
